close_reason: moved to helpers.rs, explicit import in both callers
description: submission.rs calls crate::email::find_immutable_patch_key — a pub(crate) function in email.rs. This creates an invisible dependency: the email module's patch validation logic must stay in sync with whatever submission.rs expects. If find_immutable_patch_key is renamed, its return type changes, or it moves, submission.rs breaks silently until compile time. This coupling should be made explicit: either move the function to helpers.rs where both modules can import it, or document it as part of the email module's stable internal interface.
title: find_immutable_patch_key cross-module coupling without public interface
